typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFileName as string ('gungeodf1_20231127.csv'),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Account_Type as string,
		Office_Number as string,
		Account_No as string,
		Client_Name as string,
		Trade_Date as string,
		Direction as string,
		Contract_Quantity as string,
		Product_Information as string,
		Call_Put as string,
		Strike_Price as string,
		Future_Price as string,
		Future_Code as string,
		Delivery_Month as string,
		OTE as string,
		Total_IM as string,
		Reason as string,
		Counterparty_Broker as string,
		Currency as string,
		Conversion_Rate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource split(Account_No == '', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(BR,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput derive(FileName = toString((right($sFileName, 22))),
		FileDate = (substring(toString($sFileName), toInteger(11), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString($sFileName), toInteger(15), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString($sFileName), toInteger(17), toInteger(2))),
		TradeDate = toString((substring(toString(Trade_Date), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(Trade_Date), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(Trade_Date), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of FileName} = FileName,
		{Copy of TradeDate} = TradeDate) ~> DataConversion
DerivedColumn aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DataConversion sink(input(
		Client_Name as string,
		OTE as string,
		Trade_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Account_Type as string,
		FileName as string,
		Future_Code as string,
		Delivery_Month as string,
		Direction as string,
		Total_IM as string,
		Reason as string,
		Conversion_Rate as string,
		FileDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Product_Information as string,
		Counterparty_Broker as string,
		Future_Price as string,
		Strike_Price as string,
		Currency as string,
		Call_Put as string,
		Office_Number as string,
		Account_No as string,
		Contract_Quantity as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Client_Name,
		OTE,
		Trade_Date = {Copy of TradeDate},
		Account_Type,
		FileName = {Copy of FileName},
		Future_Code,
		Delivery_Month,
		Direction,
		Total_IM,
		Reason,
		Conversion_Rate,
		FileDate,
		Product_Information,
		Counterparty_Broker,
		Future_Price,
		Strike_Price,
		Currency,
		Call_Put,
		Office_Number,
		Account_No,
		Contract_Quantity),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
